name: GoodDay Choco Chip
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL(PALM), CHOCOLATE CHIPS (11%) [SUGAR, COCOA SOLIDS, COCOA BUTTER, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER (322) AND ADDED NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA)] CHOCOCHIPS (10%) [SUGAR EDIBLE HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), COCOA SOLIDS, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER(322) AND ADDED NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA)], INVERT SYRUP RAISING AGENTS [503(ii),500(ii),450(i)], COCOA SOLIDS, EDIBLE COMMON SALT AND EMULSIFIERS (322,472e) CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (150d) AND ADDED FLAVOURS [NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE & VANILLA)]
